heading: Recommended setup
intro: From the last 7 days of Persona's own records. Nothing was changed: each of these stays off until you turn it on.
delegate: Let the assistant answer agents' questions: {n} times you answered an agent's question with exactly what its supervisor recommended; the assistant would have answered those for you. Cost: one model call per question, and the answer reaches the agent before you see it. Where: {setting} in manager.json.
standing_authorizations: Standing authorizations: {n} times you approved a merge, a push or a test deploy that you had already approved in the same directory; a standing authorization would not have asked again. Cost: Persona then does that step there without asking, within the conditions on the grant. Where: Settings › Assistant profile › Standing authorizations ({setting}).
task_trust: Start tasks directly: {n} plans waited for Start although you had already started tasks of the same kind (same computer and directory); a remembered kind starts without asking. Cost: those tasks start, and spend tokens, before you have read the plan. Where: "Start these right away from now on" on a plan card ({setting}).
triage_decide: Session triage, cards for your decisions: {n} times an agent stopped to wait for you with no card, and went on only after you wrote to it; each stop would have been a card. Cost: no extra model call beyond the triage you already run, and one more card per stop. Where: Settings › Agents › Session triage ({setting}).
triage_auto_continue: Session triage, continue automatically: {n} times you continued by hand an agent that had stopped on a usage limit; it would have been continued once the limit reset. Cost: each continue runs a turn of the agent on its own model. Where: Settings › Agents › Session triage ({setting}).
triage_wake: Session triage, wake waiting agents: {n} times an agent waiting on something else (CI, a deploy, another agent) went on only after you wrote to it; it would have been woken to check. Cost: each wake runs a turn of the agent on its own model. Where: Settings › Agents › Session triage ({setting}).
leaders: Pinned (leader) conversations: {n} of the main chat's rounds ({minutes} min) were follow-ups of tasks it had handed out; a pinned conversation follows up its own direction's tasks instead. Cost: each pinned conversation keeps its own context and spends tokens on it. Where: Pin in a conversation's menu ({setting}).
review_sample: Spot-check reviews: {n} tasks were accepted at their first review with every criterion met and the work live; below 100 percent the done judge could have closed them itself, without a review round. Cost: the judge checks every criterion of each finished task, and only the share you set is still reviewed. Where: ask Persona to set {setting}.
independent_review: Independent review: {n} times a supervisor sent work the judge had called done back for rework; an independent reviewer reads each finished change first and sends back what it finds. Cost: one more agent run for every finished task. Where: {setting} in manager.json.
